name: Acmer K1
tagline: Acmer's enclosed mini diode line: 2.4 kg, 150 × 150 mm, from 2.5W to 12W
tldr: The Acmer K1 is a small enclosed diode engraver: a 150 × 150 mm area in a 286 × 273 × 190 mm box weighing 2.4 kg, with a lid sensor, a tilt sensor and a built-in exhaust fan. Acmer sells it in four diode powers, 2.5W, 3.5W, 7W and 12W, from $179.99 to $269.99 (the 2.5W was out of stock in October 2026). It connects by USB and works with ACMER Studio, LightBurn and LaserGRBL. Open a power tier for exact specs.
mainObjective: Enclosed small-item engraving at home for the price of an open mini laser

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cut: Plywood and paulownia (Acmer chart: 5 mm at 2.5W to 12 mm at 12W, passes not stated)

pros: Enclosed box with lid and tilt sensors from $199.99
2.4 kg and 286 × 273 × 190 mm: easy to store or carry
Works with LightBurn and LaserGRBL as well as ACMER Studio
cons: USB only: no Wi-Fi and no camera
Cutting figures are manufacturer claims, without the number of passes
beginnerNotes: This overview covers the whole Acmer K1 line. Same box, area and software for every version: only the diode power changes. Pick the 3.5W for engraving only, the 7W for engraving with light cutting, the 12W if you want to cut thin plywood regularly.
proTips: Run the exhaust hose to a window: the fan pushes smoke out of the box, it does not filter it. Test power and speed on scrap, and plan several passes for any cut thicker than 2 to 3 mm.
primaryUse: Enclosed mini diode engraver for small objects at home

faq.question: Which K1 power should I choose?
faq.answer: Same box, area and software for every version. The 3.5W ($199.99) is for engraving, the 7W ($229.99) adds light cutting, and the 12W ($269.99) cuts thin plywood faster. The 2.5W ($179.99) was out of stock on Acmer's store in October 2026.

faq.question: Is the K1 safe to use indoors?
faq.answer: The box is enclosed, the laser stops when the lid opens or the machine tilts more than 13°, and a fan pushes smoke out through a hose. Smoke still has to go outside: vent the hose to a window.
